The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. The bidder shall quote with bid-specific authorization directly from the OEM; otherwise, the offer will be summarily rejected without any back reference, and no representation will be entertained. The OEM’s auth orization certificate must be on the company’s letterhead and shall contain the full name, designation, acti ve e-mail address, and mobile number of the authorized signatory, along with the company’s stamp. Witho ut these details, the OEM authorization certificate will not be considered valid, and the offer will be summa rily rejected without any back reference. The buyer may seek authentication of the authorization certificat e from the OEM, if required . 2. The bidder shall submit EMD @ 2% of the estimated value (item-wise) or proper exemption documents , i .e., MSME certificate or GeM Vendor Assessment Report for the tendered item. 3. For past performance, the firm shall attach proof of supply signed by either the purchaser, consignee, o r inspector nominated by the purchaser (not a firm representative). Documents such as receipt notes, CRA C, receipted challans, work completion certificates, etc., should be attached. Proof of supply must clearly i ndicate the quantity supplied and the date of supply. Copies of purchase orders, GeM contracts, self-signe d tax invoices, or self-prepared performance statements will not be considered as proof of past performan ce. 4. Scope of Supply (Bid price shall include all cost components): (i) Supply, installation, testing, commissio ning of goods, training of operators, and provision of statutory clearances, if any. (ii) Necessary modificatio n work for the installation of the DG set, if required, shall be carried out by the seller (iii) Any other materia ls required for the installation or commissioning of the DG set shall be provided by the seller. (iv) Loading, unloading, transportation, and proper packing of the DG sets shall be the responsibility of the supplier. 5. Place of Supply and Installation: Center Hospital, New Delhi. 6. PAYMENT TERMS: 100% payment shall be made after installation and successful commissioning of the D G set. 7. . The bidder shall submit FORM-A (Standing Indemnity Bond for on -Account Payments), Anexure - A & B after filling with signature and stamp. Merely signing, stamping or submtting catalouge without exact spec ifications will lead to summarily rejection of the bid without any clarification. 8. If the firm fails to upload any required certificate/document along with the bid, the offer will be summari ly rejected. No Fresh documents will be entertained at stage of representation. This will be goverened by p ara 7.5.2 of Manual of procurement of Goods issued by Ministry of Finance. .
